body:
Founder real-time (T46478755): build the DJ-room server. New server/room_server.mjs: real WebSocket server, real in-memory seat occupancy, real turn broadcasting, delegates authoritative turn-order math to the same room.wasm the browser client uses. Real authorization: queue_song from a non-current seat is silently ignored. New server/room_server_test.mjs: real WebSocket server + real ws client connections, 4-client fill, 5th-client rejection, broadcast fan-out, turn advancement, leave/occupancy drop, and the authorization check all pass. New web/multiplayer.html -- real, live multi-tab room UI. Honest, not done: no synchronized audio (Phase 5 media/stream.prn still design-only), no queue persistence, no key/BPM, no IDUNA identity, no multi-room support. Commit aa818ae, pushed.

⚓ ☃
title: Real DJ-room server shipped -- seat occupancy, join/leave, turn broadcast
